source_mapping: Research/Submission.lean formalizes the full selected theorem in /spec/source.txt (paper.tex, lines 703–1270): the one-step error bound with exactly c1,c2,G,eta,q,p,alpha,beta, and both the finite-k and limsup consequences under alpha < 1. Vectors use Fin n; block indexing is a bijection Fin n ≃ Fin B × Fin T. Arithmetic and Conversion specify only elementary relative rounding errors; tiledMatVec, cholesky, the triangular solves and iterates have actual bodies. Positive block/tile sizes, S dividing n, nonnegative roundoff with us < uc, valid gamma denominators, SPD blocks, successful computed Cholesky completion, A=D+N, Ax=b and eta<1 are explicit. The tiled reduction follows the kernel specified in the selected paper proof; successful Cholesky completion interprets the computed-factor execution and matches the earlier Cholesky-solve assumptions. No residual, solver, or recurrence estimate is an input hypothesis. Statement revision after reading /spec/feedback.json: none; feedback reports only the unfinished proof. The theorem proof retains one temporary sorry for deriving the one-step bound; the attached scalar recurrence consequences are already proved. Supporting source copies in Research/Sources are unchanged; /spec/support contains no files.
